long_biography.plain_text:
Rontis combines pharmaceutical research and manufacturing with the medical-device activities from which the group first developed. As vice-president and chief executive, Periklis Vasilopoulos has directed expansion into new markets while adding production and product-development capacity. The company now makes medicines and interventional devices through specialised plants and an in-house research laboratory.

That operating model grew from a distribution business which introduced international medical technologies into markets lacking specialist supply chains. Rontis then moved into manufacturing its own devices, infant-nutrition products and medicines. Vasilopoulos has concentrated on integrating those activities into an export-led healthcare group rather than relying on a single product line.
